text:
nina (AE): Heads up: Helios Health asked for a 3-week POC next Wed. They want committed monthly pricing, throughput sizing for ~7.5k rps peak (~550 tokens avg), and BYOK/HSM details + 12mo logs.

omar (SE): Finance insists on reserved capacity. They want AZ-fallback and clear tail-latency numbers.

jin (Solutions): Quick thumb: recommend reserved pool = 3 GPUs (A40-class equiv) with autoscale headroom to 5. Autoscale suggestion: min=3 target_gpu_util=0.68 max=5 cooldown=90s. If they opt into 8-bit quantization, throughput ~x1.6 so 2 reserved could suffice but risk on mixed workloads.

nina (AE): Can you give 1-paragraph tradeoff for 3 vs 5 reserved and 2+burst credits? procurement will want monthly deltas.

jin (Solutions): Short bullets: 3 reserved = predictable cost, best p99; 5 reserved = +40% cost for smoother spikes and lower queuing; 2 reserved + burst = ~-20% cost but with higher p99 and potential degraded UX under sustained surges. Will produce exact $ numbers in ticket.

anya (Security): BYOK/HSM: we support customer-managed keys and partner HSM wrapping as an enterprise add-on. Dedicated deployment simplifies EU residency and KMScontrol. I'll draft questionnaire answers and attach SOC2 evidence.

omar (SE): Prewarm plan? we should include KV warmup and a synthetic ramp smoke test.

jin (Solutions): Prewarm snippet: ```yaml
prewarm:
  kv_warmup: true
  concurrency: 8
  ramp_seconds: 600
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 3
  max_replicas: 5
  target_gpu_utilization: 0.68
```

jin (Solutions): Smoke test: ramp 0->7.5k rps over 12m, capture p50/p95/p99 and token_cost.csv. Example load command: `loadgen --target 7500 --ramp 720 --payload=chat_550.json --capture=p99 --report=token_cost.csv`.

nina (AE): Timeline: questionnaire answers by Fri EOD, pricing sheet by Mon, infra deploy on Tue. Can team hit it?

jin (Solutions): Yes. I'll open a ticket and attach calc, prewarm, and smoke test.

ticket_bot: created SRV-10422 "Helios POC: reserved capacity + HSM addendum" assigned to jin, due 2026-04-04.

anya (Security): Note: if they require FIPS-level HSM we need legal + procurement signoff. I'll mark that in the draft.

omar (SE): Also call out quantized vs full-precision pricing bins in the sheet.

jin (Solutions): Will add quantized multipliers and per-1k-response cost estimates at 512/550 tokens.

nina (AE): Great, I'll update customer and attach SRV-10422. End of thread.
